answer: Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
